descriptions.d24f_hit_test_items_802bc7c0: Hit-tests a panel's items at (x, y): clears both outputs, fetches the node's box (node slot at +88, vtable +124) into a local, copies its origin (box +36), converts the point to local coordinates, and for each item with id != -1 calls 0x802bfa70; on a hit it stores the item's id and returns 1. Returns 0 otherwise.
